Android moves apps between buckets based on use. A bucket set here can change again when you use the app.
Android may move the app to another bucket when you use it.

Able offers the same three choices as Android App battery usage:

• Restricted: RUN_ANY_IN_BACKGROUND and RUN_IN_BACKGROUND set to "ignore" and the app removed from the battery-optimization allowlist. Android stops background jobs and limits alarms while you are not using the app.
• Optimized (Android default): both controls "allow", not on the allowlist. Android limits the app with Doze and app standby.
• Unrestricted: both controls "allow" and the app added to the battery-optimization allowlist (Doze does not limit it). This can use more battery.

Apps on the system allowlist are kept unrestricted by Android; Able cannot change that.

Risk: Restricted can stop or delay notifications, alarms, reminders, sync, backups and widgets. Do not restrict messaging, alarm, health or security apps you rely on.

Undo: choose another option at any time. Able never restricts itself, Shizuku or core Android components, and never applies these changes automatically.

Android places every app in a standby bucket based on how recently and often you use it, and limits jobs, alarms and network access accordingly (Restricted is the strongest).

Risk: a lower bucket can delay notifications and sync.

Undo: choose Active, or simply open the app: Android moves apps back up when you use them.

Android lets only system tools read and change the background controls of other apps. Shizuku gives Able that access after you start it with wireless debugging or root.\n\nWithout Shizuku, open Android App info → App battery usage for the same app.
No background jobs; alarms limited while the app is not in use.
Android default: limited by Doze and app standby.
Not limited by battery optimization. May use more battery.
The app is on the battery-optimization allowlist but its background activity is restricted. Choose an option to make the settings consistent.
Android did not report all settings needed to show the battery usage option.
Android keeps this app unrestricted (system allowlist). Able cannot make it Optimized or Restricted.
Android exempts this app from app standby (system list); Doze still applies.
If an app is unrestricted, Able also removes it from the battery-optimization allowlist. Apps kept unrestricted by Android only get their background activity restricted.
Blocks mobile data only while the app is in the background. Wi-Fi and use in the foreground are not affected.
Android did not report the background data setting of this app.

Adds the app to Android's background data restriction (the same as turning off "Background data" in App info → Mobile data). The restriction applies to the app's UID, so apps sharing a UID are affected together.

Risk: on mobile data, sync, messages and notifications that need the network may arrive only when you open the app or connect to Wi-Fi.

Undo: turn the switch off. Wi-Fi and foreground use are never blocked.
Saves these background settings on this device. Able warns you if an app update or Android changes them.
Available when Android reports the current background settings through Shizuku.
Reviewed on %1$s. The current settings match.
Reviewed on %1$s. The current settings differ.
Able could not save the review on this device. Try again.
Different now: %1$s. An app update or Android may have reset them.
Their background settings no longer match your review. An app update or Android may have reset them.
Able re-applies only the settings that differ from your review and reads each app back. Apps you restricted when reviewing will be restricted again.

Marking an app as reviewed saves its background jobs and alarms setting, background running, battery-optimization allowlist and background mobile data on this device only. The standby bucket is not saved because Android changes it on its own.

If the live settings later differ, Able shows "Changed since review" and offers to restore them. Nothing is restored automatically.

Undo: Forget removes the saved review; your settings stay as they are.
